verification_report.summary: The proof is correct. It sets up a minimal-counterexample descent, uses the second root c = kb - a of the associated monic quadratic, proves c is a positive integer with c < b, and obtains a strictly smaller positive solution with the same nonsquare quotient, contradicting minimality. All algebraic and order arguments are justified, the statement is self-contained, and there are no external references or hard-prohibition violations.
